user.description: Where should the surplus be calculated from?

grid.title: Grid sensor
grid.description: A bidirectional sensor: positive when importing, negative when exporting.

data_description.invert_grid: Enable if the sensor reports positive values while exporting.

split.title: Separate sensors
split.description: Both values must always be positive.

data_description.consumption_includes_battery: Enable if the consumption sensor already counts battery charging.

battery.title: Home battery
battery.description: Optional — leave empty and confirm if you have none.

data_description.battery_power_entity: A bidirectional sensor: positive when charging, negative when discharging.
data_description.battery_charge_entity: Alternative to the bidirectional sensor: two always-positive sensors.
data_description.battery_mode: Charging power always counts as available. The question is whether discharging should reduce the surplus.
data_description.battery_min_soc: Below this, charging takes priority and no surplus is reported.
data_description.battery_reserve_w: Power always kept for the battery.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Manager is already set up.

data_description.smoothing_window: Smooths the surplus so passing clouds do not cause switching storms. 0 disables smoothing.
data_description.settle_time: After a switch, the same load is left alone for this long. Prevents the automation from reacting to the effect of its own action.

data_description.power_entity: Current power draw. Without it the rated power is used.
data_description.min_power: Surplus required before switching on is worthwhile. Defaults to the rated power.
data_description.hysteresis: Dead band against oscillation around zero.
data_description.turn_on_delay: The surplus must be sufficient for this long before switching on. Debounces brief gaps in sunshine.
data_description.turn_off_delay: The deficit must persist this long before switching off. Rides out passing clouds.
data_description.min_runtime: The device stays on at least this long after being switched on.
data_description.min_off_time: The device stays off at least this long after being switched off. Protects compressors from restarting too early.

options.split: Separate sensors for production and consumption

force_on.name: Force on
force_on.description: Turns a load on immediately and keeps it on for the given duration, regardless of surplus. Works even with the main switch off — this is an operation, not an automation decision.

device_id.name: Load
device_id.description: The load's device. An entity of the same device works as well.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the automation will not turn the device back off.

clear_force.name: End forced run
clear_force.description: Cancels a running forced run early. Nothing is turned off — from now on the surplus decides again.

device_id.name: Load
device_id.description: The load's device. An entity of the same device works as well.

pause.name: Pause automation
pause.description: Stops the automation. Without a duration it stays off until resumed manually.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The automation resumes by itself after this time. Leave empty for indefinite.

not_loaded.message: The Energy Manager integration is not set up.

not_a_consumer.message: {target} is not an Energy Manager load.
